score_scope: M118 milestone including the M115-r2 arithmetic bridge and evidence boundaries

decision.reason: The frozen r2 campaign and a separately authored commercial-VCS hammer agree on the signed19 accumulator implementation. However, M115-r2 proves a coefficient-prefix bound only when anchor/correction operations are accepted exactly once; neither r2 nor the independent standalone hammer proves this integrated premise.

m115r2_mathematical_candidate_audit.critical_condition: Any duplicate, retry or replayed accepted anchor/correction can make a source-term prefix coefficient exceed magnitude one and invalidates the signed19 proof.

failed_r1_provenance.rule: A simulator PASS line cannot override the fail-closed runner receipt. Only sealed r2 is citable.

findings.finding: The signed19 bound is conditional on exact-once accepted anchor and correction transactions, but the integrated accepted-transaction miter is explicitly false.
findings.impact: Standalone accumulator correctness does not prove that the real bridge cannot duplicate or replay a contribution. One repeated accepted term can violate the magnitude-one prefix proof and invalidate the checkpoint no-overflow guarantee.
findings.required_next_evidence: Run an exact heldout controller/payload/accumulator replay with sequence identities and conservation assertions proving every planned operation is accepted exactly once, with no duplicate, retry or replay.

findings.finding: The 96 lane memories are behavioral arrays, not legal foundry macro instances.
findings.impact: Macro rounding, periphery, RDW mode, read latency and 1824-bit routing can change area, energy, timing and II=1 feasibility.
findings.required_next_evidence: Select legal macros and close macro-inclusive DC, STA and PTPX with frozen port semantics.

findings.finding: The module uses fail-fast ingress and reset-only quarantine for same-address requests.
findings.impact: A producer that holds valid while semantically blocked or emits adjacent equal addresses can stop the module even though conventional ready/valid producers would expect a stall.
findings.required_next_evidence: Freeze a pulse-on-credit producer and prove zero adjacent equal accepted addresses in the exact replay.

findings.finding: Payload decoding, lane sign extension, descriptor completion and sequence identity are outside M118.
findings.impact: The standalone tests cannot expose payload-to-delta lane swaps or duplicate descriptor service that would break the signed19 premise.
findings.required_next_evidence: Integrate M118 behind the exact payload bridge and compare every accepted delta and final commit with an integer oracle.

findings.finding: No Formality, matched signed24 netlist, timing or power evidence exists.
findings.impact: The 184320-byte logical reduction is not measured macro area, energy, frequency or performance.
findings.required_next_evidence: Run equivalence and matched macro-inclusive signed19 versus signed24 PPA.

findings.finding: Commit scans all 8x384 vectors without a valid_rows bound.
findings.impact: Partial final windows still consume padded commit cycles.
findings.required_next_evidence: Charge padding in the cycle ledger or verify a bounded commit iterator.

findings.finding: Faults do not export the offending sequence or update identity.
findings.impact: The integration wrapper must define attribution, reset and replay policy without accidentally violating exact-once.
findings.required_next_evidence: Add outer sequence-aware conservation and fail-closed recovery bookkeeping.

findings.finding: The r1 directory contains a VCS PASS line but ended with a fail-closed runner receipt and no RUN_COMPLETE.
findings.impact: Using r1 would bypass the evidence pipeline and create ambiguous cover-count provenance.
findings.required_next_evidence: Reference only r2 and preserve r1 solely as a negative provenance artifact.

findings.finding: Signed19 is limited to the four frozen checkpoint payloads and the M115-r2 coefficient contract.
findings.impact: Retrained weights or arbitrary dense INT8 reuse can overflow; the dense mathematical candidate requires signed21.
findings.required_next_evidence: Bind deployment to checkpoint/weight digests and rerun the bound after any weight or stream-semantic change.

paper_safe_statement: The M118 standalone W384 accumulator, organized as 96 logical 3072x19 behavioral synchronous lane memories, passed exact-SHA sealed-r2 and independent Synopsys VCS verification of signed19 endpoints, 96-lane RMW, nonconflicting II=1, lazy clear, commit backpressure/order, same-address fail-closed behavior and positive/negative overflow. It stores 1824-bit vectors with a 700416-byte accumulator payload and a 725416-byte combined logical lower bound, saving 184320 logical payload bytes versus signed24. The signed19 checkpoint guarantee remains a mathematical candidate until integrated exact-once accepted-transaction replay passes; foundry SRAM, physical PPA, cycle/system/headline speedups remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not cite the failed/incomplete r1 directory as a passing run.
Do not call standalone accumulator VCS an integrated exact-once proof.
Do not call behavioral lane arrays foundry SRAM macros.
Do not call 184320 logical bytes measured area, energy or performance.
Do not generalize signed19 to arbitrary dense INT8; M115-r2 requires signed21.
Do not call the M109 2.535462x projection M118-measured, physical, system or headline speedup.
